statement: The Employment Act covers every employee working under a contract of service with an employer — local or foreign, full-time, part-time, temporary or contract — with seafarers, domestic workers and public servants excluded; Part 4 of the Act, which provides for rest days, hours of work and other conditions of service, does not cover managers or executives.
caveat: Employers must also issue written key employment terms within 14 days of the start of employment, and foreign employees additionally sit under the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act's work-pass conditions. The statutory source is the Employment Act 1968.
reviewer: Starter editorial review; independent domain expert review pending
